official_scoring_profile.evidence_limit: Synthetic design reference derived from published Qwen throughput plus explicit engineering assumptions; it is not target-device measurement or production latency.

semantic_generation.cloud_network_provider_latency_treatment: record as Track-B diagnostic if observed; exclude from architecture score

timing.profile_type: evidence-anchored synthetic on-device reference latency profile
timing.common_candidate_policy: Every compared alternative consumes the same frozen semantic result and reference latency sample for a comparable operation.

memory.denominator_definition: One unavoidable minimum physical instance of the frozen required AI stack for the same workload.
memory.physical_accounting: Shared physical pages count once; true replicas count separately; required memory in another process remains included.

replacement_policy: When real target hardware becomes available, create a new Reference Environment version and replace latency/memory calibration sources. Hardware recalibration alone does not redefine QA targets, populations, or score bands.
